design: One fresh consumer, sequential crossover: text, guided_text, json. Answers saved before reading the next packet; implementation, fixtures, intent, spec and key withheld until all answers were saved. Not independent samples or randomized estimates.
scoring: Manual semantic assessment against observations and key, preserving unknown versus false. The key ready=false for operational failures means readiness cannot be granted, not a proven underlying failed intake. Consumer unknown is justified for C04-C06. Unknown completeness in text C02/C03 is justified and is not an error.

C06.text: safe recovery; completion false not established by crash alone
C06.guided_text: safe recovery; completion false not established by crash alone
C06.json: safe recovery; completion false not established by crash alone

summary.crash_control_limit: All answers set completion false. Safe recovery is correct, but a crash alone does not establish how many checks ran. The injected key accepts false or unknown; do not generalize this score to real crash completeness.
summary.recommendation: Prefer guidance-only under REQ-3; do not retain JSON on an unmeasured readability claim.
